notes.title: Rebel Engine - PAX West Announcement
notes.notes: [h1]Good Afternoon everyone![/h1][p][/p][h3]The game, formerly known as 'Payloaders Strike', now known as 'Rebel Engine' will be attending an indie showcase at PAX West 2025 in Seattle![/h3][p][/p][h2][b]Our developers will be on site with a NEW, UPDATED Demo for the game! There will also be contests for top scorers every day as well as gift giveaways for wishlisters![/b][/h2][h2][/h2][h2][b]Join us at the PAX West show floor! Booth #747 in the Arch Building, from August 29th - September 1st![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42329738/d8572a23278804545bb417c1c80e26b39c71d9a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]We hope to get to meet some of you, our community at this awesome event! We also will be looking forward to bringing you more news regarding the progress made for the game coming soon![/h2][h3][/h3][h3]Rebel Engine Team[/h3]

notes.title: Payloaders Strike! Demo out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42329738/3f25c5eec79f5b7e38658aa5b7c55839bb02eea5.png[/img]

[h2]Try out the first level of the campaign and the arena mode in our Demo![/h2]

[h3]Featuring:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Vicious robot violence
[*] Flashy gun and melee combos
[*] Challenging combat encounters
[*] Robot workers having an average day
[*] A grappling hook
[/list]

You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/Dm7tMWJ6y5]Discord Server[/url] to chat with the community and leave your reviews and feedback. 

Hope you enjoy the Demo!
